messages:
sanjay: Quick heads-up — I ran a short bakeoff comparing AWQ-int8 / GPTQ / FP8 on nova-70b with prefetch + continuous batching enabled. Seeing a ~12ms p99 uplift for AWQ when prefix-cache hit rate drops below ~70%.

emily: ouch. do you have the query mix?

sanjay: small golden set (2000 prompts), mixed short/long. Most regressed cases are short-context Q/A where prefetch mispredicts viable kv keys.

kai: is this the same prefetch heuristic we tuned last quarter?

sanjay: yes, the heuristic that fetches top-2 next-block keys per request. When hit rate falls, AWQ's decode path seems to increase variance (likely because of modularized kernels + cache thrash).

luca: any logs/metrics? p50/p95/p99?

sanjay: perf-bot posted the quick summary: 
```
model: nova-70b-awq-int8 | prefetch: on | batch_delay_ms: 8
p50: 18ms p95: 42ms p99: 96ms
model: nova-70b-gptq | prefetch: on | batch_delay_ms: 8
p50: 17ms p95: 40ms p99: 84ms
model: nova-70b-fp8  | prefetch: on | batch_delay_ms: 8
p50: 16ms p95: 39ms p99: 80ms

note: AWQ p99 jumps only when prefix-cache hit < 70%
```

emily: do we see the same if prefetch disabled?

sanjay: disabled run result: AWQ p99 drops to 82ms (so ~14ms improvement vs prefetch-on). GPTQ/FP8 unaffected (±2ms).

kai: that smells like an interaction between AWQ's per-token kernel fallback and KV cache evictions. maybe prefetch is thrashing L2/L3 on those GPU types.

luca: which infra did you run on? g5dn? a100?

sanjay: internal-metal-a100-2 (our standard inference node). I can repro on a different host.

perf-bot: [perf-dashboard] https://perf.internal/boards/nova-70b/prefetch-bake/1901234567

emily: can you repro with continuous batching off? curious whether batching coalesces mispredicted prefixes into larger batches and amplifies variance.

sanjay: good idea — running now.

(small pause)

sanjay: results: continuous batching off (prefetch on) => AWQ p99 = 85ms. So both prefetch and batching together produce the worst tail.

kai: ok actionable: either (A) tighten prefetch heuristic threshold for AWQ-int8, (B) add a short-circuit in AWQ runtime to prefer cached kv path when cache miss ratio high, or (C) route AWQ requests to lower batch_delay/disable prefetch at routing layer.

emily: can we try config toggle first (C) — per-model routing flag is fastest. People running heavy short requests will benefit.

luca: suggested config to flip at runtime: 
```json
{
  "model": "nova-70b-awq-int8",
  "prefetch_enabled": false,
  "continuous_batching": { "max_delay_ms": 2 }
}
```

sanjay: I'll push a canary config to staging for 2 hours and re-run the golden set.

perf-bot: job queued: bake-run 1901234567-canary (staging), ETA 15m

emily: also file a follow-up ML task to root-cause kernel fallback path. we shouldn't rely on routing toggles long-term.

kai: agreed. assign to eng-ml (sanjay + luca) and eng-runtime (kai).

sanjay: creating ticket now. ticket: INF-2867 — "AWQ-int8 tail latency interaction with prefetch + continuous batching" — will attach logs + perf dashboard.

luca: nice. once canary results are in, we should decide whether to flip in prod for short-query SLA route.

emily: thanks for the quick triage. :thumbsup:

sanjay: np — will post canary summary here when done. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
